reviews.title: Complete three-piece Chanderi set at ₹1,499 is unmatched
reviews.comment: The handloom organza dupatta alone looks heirloom-grade. The trousers have deep pockets and a comfortable waist. Delivered in 3 days with clean packaging.

reviews.title: The Indigo Slate slub weave is my new weekend staple
reviews.comment: Finally a men’s kurta under ₹1,000 that doesn’t look boxy or synthetic. The slub khadi texture and mandarin collar sit sharply with both jeans and linen trousers.

aboutAhuza.headline: Crafted for the Rhythm of Everyday India.
aboutAhuza.storyParagraph1: AHUZA ("Where Fashion Meets Passion") was founded on a simple conviction: elevated Indian everyday wear should never demand luxury markups. Too often, shoppers are forced to choose between synthetic fast fashion under ₹1,000 or overpriced occasionwear above ₹5,000.
aboutAhuza.storyParagraph2: By partnering directly with weaving clusters in Jaipur, Surat, and Tiruppur and eliminating middleman distribution, we craft breathable mulmul kurtis, Chanderi kurta sets with handloom dupattas, everyday lehengas, and tailored menswear—with an ironclad brand rule that no product ever exceeds ₹2,000 INR.
aboutAhuza.craftsmanshipPromise: Every garment undergoes 3-stage shrinkage testing, natural azo-free dyeing, and seam reinforcement before earning the AHUZA woven label.

policies.privacyPolicy: AHUZA respects your privacy. Personal account details (name, email, phone, shipping addresses) are securely protected and used strictly for order fulfillment and seamless communication. We never sell or share your data with third parties.
policies.termsAndConditions: By shopping on AHUZA, you agree to our transparent pricing policy where all products are listed in Indian Rupees (INR) inclusive of GST, with a maximum selling price of ₹2,000 per item. Orders are confirmed only upon server-side payment verification.
policies.shippingPolicy: We dispatch all confirmed orders within 24 hours from our Mumbai fulfillment studio. Standard delivery takes 2–5 business days across all serviceable pin codes in India. Orders above ₹999 qualify for complimentary shipping; orders below ₹999 incur a flat ₹79 shipping fee.
policies.cancellationPolicy: You may request an instant order cancellation from My Orders before the shipment reaches "Shipped" status. Once approved, full refunds are initiated immediately to your original payment method.
policies.returnRefundPolicy: We offer a 14-day easy return policy from the date of delivery for unused, unwashed garments with original tags intact. Once our quality team marks your return as received, refunds are initiated via Razorpay and credited once confirmed by the banking provider (typically 3–5 business days).
